senses.en: because of

ex.en: The match was cancelled due to heavy rain.
ex.zh: 比赛因大雨被取消。

ex.en: The delay was due to a technical problem.
ex.zh: 延误是由于技术问题。

tip: due to 是正式说法，等于 because of，后接名词。
scene: A rainy football pitch with an umbrella and a cancelled sign.

senses.en: a soft warm quilt for a bed

ex.en: I bought a new duvet for the winter.
ex.zh: 我买了一条新羽绒被过冬。

ex.en: The bed has a white duvet and soft pillows.
ex.zh: 床上有白色羽绒被和柔软的枕头。

tip: duvet 是英式说法，指羽绒被。
scene: A cosy bed with a thick white duvet and pillows.

senses.en: pain in your ear

ex.en: The child cried because of an earache.
ex.zh: 孩子因为耳朵疼哭了起来。

ex.en: She has an earache after swimming.
ex.zh: 游泳后她耳朵疼。

tip: earache 耳朵疼；toothache 牙疼；stomach ache 肚子疼。
scene: A child holding their ear and looking uncomfortable in bed.

senses.en: calm and relaxed in character

ex.en: Our new teacher is very easygoing.
ex.zh: 我们的新老师很随和。

ex.en: She is easygoing and gets on with everyone.
ex.zh: 她很随和，和每个人都合得来。

tip: easygoing 形容人随和、不挑剔。
scene: A relaxed teacher smiling with students in a classroom.

senses.en: to finally be in a situation or place

ex.en: We got lost and ended up at the beach.
ex.zh: 我们迷路了，最后到了海滩。

ex.en: He studied hard and ended up with a good job.
ex.zh: 他努力学习，最后得到了一份好工作。

tip: end up 表示“最终落得/到达某状态”，后接介词短语或动名词。
scene: Two friends laughing as they arrive at a beach after getting lost.

senses.en: although; despite the fact that

ex.en: Even though it was cold, we went swimming.
ex.zh: 尽管天冷，我们还是去游泳了。

ex.en: She passed the exam even though she was ill.
ex.zh: 尽管她生病了，还是通过了考试。

tip: even though 比 although 语气更强，强调“即使…仍然…”。
scene: People swimming in a pool with snow falling outside the window.

senses.en: a person who tests or judges exams

ex.en: The examiner asked me three questions.
ex.zh: 考官问了我三个问题。

ex.en: She was nervous when the examiner walked in.
ex.zh: 考官进来时她很紧张。

tip: examiner 是考官，在考试中出题/评分的人。
scene: An examiner sitting at a desk with papers in an exam room.

senses.en: tests at school or university

ex.en: I have three exams next week.
ex.zh: 我下周有三场考试。

ex.en: She studies hard before the exams.
ex.zh: 考试前她努力学习。

tip: exams 是 exam 的复数；final exams 是期末考试。
scene: A desk with exam papers and a clock in a quiet hall.

senses.en: the value of one currency in another

ex.en: The exchange rate between the two currencies changed today.
ex.zh: 今天这两种货币的汇率变了。

ex.en: You can check the exchange rate online.
ex.zh: 你可以在网上查汇率。

tip: exchange rate 是汇率；currency exchange 是货币兑换。
scene: A currency exchange board showing different exchange rates.

senses.en: having skill from doing something for a long time

ex.en: She is an experienced driver.
ex.zh: 她是一位有经验的司机。

ex.en: The experienced teacher helped the new students.
ex.zh: 经验丰富的老师帮助了新学生。

tip: experienced 是形容词“有经验的”；反义 inexperienced。
scene: An experienced pilot in uniform speaking to young trainees.

senses.en: a dangerous and exciting sport

ex.en: Skydiving is an extreme sport.
ex.zh: 跳伞是一项极限运动。

ex.en: He loves extreme sports like rock climbing.
ex.zh: 他喜欢攀岩之类的极限运动。

tip: extreme sport 是极限运动，如跳伞、攀岩、冲浪等。
scene: A rock climber scaling a steep cliff face.

senses.en: in person, looking at each other

ex.en: We talked face to face instead of texting.
ex.zh: 我们面对面交谈而不是发短信。

ex.en: She wanted to meet the singer face to face.
ex.zh: 她想和歌手面对面见面。

tip: face to face 是“面对面地”。
scene: Two people sitting across a table talking face to face.

senses.en: buildings, rooms or equipment for a purpose

ex.en: The hotel has great sports facilities.
ex.zh: 这家酒店有很棒的运动设施。

ex.en: The school's facilities include a library and a gym.
ex.zh: 学校的设施包括图书馆和体育馆。

tip: facilities 常用复数，指场所提供的设施。
scene: A modern sports centre with a gym and swimming pool signs.

senses.en: land used for farming

ex.en: The village is surrounded by green farmland.
ex.zh: 村庄被绿色的农田环绕。

ex.en: Farmland stretches to the hills in the distance.
ex.zh: 农田一直延伸到远处的山丘。

tip: farmland 是耕地/农田。
scene: Green fields of crops stretching to distant hills with a farmhouse.

senses.en: a machine that sends copies of documents by phone lines

ex.en: Please send the form by fax.
ex.zh: 请把表格用传真发过来。

ex.en: She faxed the contract to the office.
ex.zh: 她把合同传真到办公室。

tip: fax 可作名词“传真”或动词“发传真”。
scene: An office fax machine sending out a sheet of paper.

senses.en: to want something, or to seem

ex.en: I feel like having pizza for dinner.
ex.zh: 晚饭我想吃披萨。

ex.en: It feels like spring already.
ex.zh: 感觉已经是春天了。

tip: feel like + 名词/动名词 表示“想要…”。
scene: A girl looking at a pizza menu and smiling.

senses.en: to make something completely full

ex.en: We filled up the car with petrol.
ex.zh: 我们把汽车加满了油。

ex.en: Fill up the bottle with water, please.
ex.zh: 请把瓶子装满水。

col: fill up the tank｜加满油箱
tip: fill up 是“装满/加满”；加油时也说 fill it up。
scene: A car being filled with petrol at a station, tank full.

senses.en: a person who makes films

ex.en: The film maker won an award for the movie.
ex.zh: 这位电影制作人因这部电影获奖。

ex.en: She is a young film maker from London.
ex.zh: 她是一位来自伦敦的年轻电影制作人。

tip: film maker 是电影制作者，可指导演/制片人。
scene: A film maker holding a camera on a film set.

senses.en: next; coming after something

ex.en: The following day, we visited the museum.
ex.zh: 第二天我们参观了博物馆。

ex.en: Please answer the following questions.
ex.zh: 请回答以下问题。

tip: the following day 是“第二天”；following 也作“以下的”。
scene: A calendar with the next day circled after today.

senses.en: to cook food in hot oil

ex.en: She fried the eggs for breakfast.
ex.zh: 她煎了鸡蛋当早餐。

ex.en: Fry the onions until they are soft.
ex.zh: 把洋葱煎软。

tip: fry 是“煎/炸”；boil 煮，roast 烤。
scene: Eggs frying in a pan with oil in a kitchen.

senses.en: a flat pan used for frying food

ex.en: Heat the frying pan before adding the oil.
ex.zh: 先加热煎锅再放油。

ex.en: She put the frying pan on the stove.
ex.zh: 她把煎锅放到炉子上。

tip: frying pan 是平底煎锅；美式常说 skillet。
scene: A frying pan on a stove with oil sizzling.

senses.en: the dot at the end of a sentence (British English)

ex.en: Write a full stop at the end of each sentence.
ex.zh: 每个句子结尾要写句号。

ex.en: In the US, a full stop is called a period.
ex.zh: 在美国，句号叫 period。

tip: full stop 是英式说法；美式说 period。
scene: A sentence on a blackboard ending with a red full stop.

senses.en: working the whole week

ex.en: She has a full-time job in a hospital.
ex.zh: 她在医院有一份全职工作。

ex.en: He studies full time at university.
ex.zh: 他在大学全日制学习。

tip: full time 是“全职”；反义 part time 兼职。
scene: A nurse working full time at a hospital reception desk.

senses.en: at the greatest distance

ex.en: The furthest town is about fifty kilometres away.
ex.zh: 最远的城镇大约五十公里远。

ex.en: Who can throw the ball the furthest?
ex.zh: 谁能把球扔得最远？

tip: furthest 是 far 的最高级之一（far-farther-furthest）。
scene: A map with a red dot marking the furthest town on a road.

senses.en: a very strong wind

ex.en: The gale blew down several trees in the park.
ex.zh: 大风刮倒了公园里的几棵树。

ex.en: Strong gales are expected on the coast tonight.
ex.zh: 预计今晚沿海有大风。

tip: gale 是强风；比 breeze（微风）强得多。
scene: Trees bending in a strong gale with leaves flying.

senses.en: to move down, or to bring something down

ex.en: Get down from that tree carefully!
ex.zh: 小心地从树上下来！

ex.en: She got the books down from the high shelf.
ex.zh: 她把书从高架子上取下来。

tip: get down 表示“下来”或“取下”。
scene: A child climbing carefully down from a tree.

senses.en: to enter a place or vehicle

ex.en: Get in the car; we are leaving now.
ex.zh: 上车吧，我们现在就走。

ex.en: The train gets in at ten.
ex.zh: 火车十点到达。

tip: get in 表示“进入/上车”；车到达也说 get in。
scene: A person getting into a car through the open door.

senses.en: to remove something unwanted

ex.en: We need to get rid of this old sofa.
ex.zh: 我们需要扔掉这张旧沙发。

ex.en: He got rid of his bad habit of staying up late.
ex.zh: 他改掉了熬夜的坏习惯。

tip: get rid of 是“摆脱/处理掉”。
scene: Two people carrying an old sofa out of a house.

senses.en: to stop fighting and accept, or to hand in

ex.en: He refused to give in and kept trying.
ex.zh: 他拒绝放弃，继续尝试。

ex.en: Please give in your homework by Friday.
ex.zh: 请周五前交作业。

tip: give in 表示“屈服/让步”；英式也指“交作业”。
scene: A child finally agreeing and giving in after an argument.

senses.en: to hand things to people, or to produce

ex.en: The teacher gave out the test papers.
ex.zh: 老师分发了试卷。

ex.en: The fire gives out a lot of heat.
ex.zh: 火散发出很多热量。

tip: give out 是“分发”或“发出（光热）”。
scene: A teacher handing out papers to students in class.

senses.en: to stop trying or stop doing something

ex.en: Don't give up; you are doing well!
ex.zh: 别放弃，你做得很好！

ex.en: He gave up smoking last year.
ex.zh: 他去年戒烟了。

tip: give up 表示“放弃”或“戒除（习惯）”。
scene: A coach encouraging a tired runner not to give up.

senses.en: to stop and let others go first

ex.en: Cars must give way to pedestrians at the crossing.
ex.zh: 汽车在斑马线必须给行人让路。

ex.en: The branch gave way under the snow.
ex.zh: 树枝在雪的重压下折断了。

tip: give way 表示“让路”，也引申为“倒塌、垮掉”。
scene: A car stopping at a crossing to let pedestrians walk.

senses.en: the rise in the earth's temperature

ex.en: Global warming is caused partly by pollution.
ex.zh: 全球变暖部分是由污染造成的。

ex.en: Many countries are working to stop global warming.
ex.zh: 许多国家正在努力阻止全球变暖。

tip: global warming 是“全球变暖”，与 climate change 相关。
scene: A hot sun over melting ice with factories in the distance.

senses.en: to choose or try something

ex.en: I'll go for the salad, please.
ex.zh: 我要沙拉。

ex.en: She decided to go for the job interview.
ex.zh: 她决定去参加求职面试。

tip: go for 表示“选择、尝试”，也表“去拿”。
scene: A person choosing a salad at a food counter.

senses.en: to ring, or to become bad (about food)

ex.en: My alarm clock went off at seven.
ex.zh: 我的闹钟七点响了。

ex.en: The milk has gone off; don't drink it.
ex.zh: 牛奶变质了，别喝。

tip: go off 指闹钟“响”或食物“变质”。
scene: A ringing alarm clock beside a bed in the morning.

senses.en: to continue, or to happen

ex.en: Please go on with your story.
ex.zh: 请继续讲你的故事。

ex.en: What's going on here?
ex.zh: 这里发生了什么？

tip: go on 表示“继续”；What's going on? 是“发生了什么？”。
scene: A child continuing to read a storybook aloud.

senses.en: the player who guards the goal

ex.en: The goalkeeper saved two important shots.
ex.zh: 守门员扑救了两次关键射门。

ex.en: He is the best goalkeeper in our school team.
ex.zh: 他是我们校队最好的守门员。

tip: goalkeeper 是守门员，口语常简称 keeper。
scene: A goalkeeper in gloves diving to save a ball in a goal.

senses.en: a person who plays the guitar

ex.en: The guitarist played a beautiful solo.
ex.zh: 吉他手演奏了一段优美的独奏。

ex.en: She is a guitarist in a rock band.
ex.zh: 她是一支摇滚乐队的吉他手。

tip: guitarist 是吉他手；pianist 钢琴手。
scene: A guitarist playing an acoustic guitar on a small stage.

senses.en: a machine that blows hot air to dry hair

ex.en: She dried her hair with a hairdryer.
ex.zh: 她用吹风机吹干了头发。

ex.en: The hairdryer is in the bathroom drawer.
ex.zh: 吹风机在浴室的抽屉里。

tip: hairdryer 是吹风机（美式也拼 hair dryer）。
scene: A hairdryer on a bathroom shelf next to a mirror.

senses.en: to give something to a teacher or official

ex.en: Please hand in your homework before Friday.
ex.zh: 请在周五前交作业。

ex.en: She handed in her resignation yesterday.
ex.zh: 她昨天递交了辞职信。

tip: hand in 是“上交”；give in 也含此义。
scene: A student handing a paper to a teacher at a desk.

senses.en: to give something to each person

ex.en: The volunteers handed out water to the runners.
ex.zh: 志愿者给跑步者分发水。

ex.en: She handed out the invitations at school.
ex.zh: 她在学校分发请柬。

tip: hand out 是“分发”；handout 是名词“讲义”。
scene: Volunteers handing out bottles of water to runners.

senses.en: small enough to hold in your hand

ex.en: He played games on a hand-held device.
ex.zh: 他在手持设备上玩游戏。

ex.en: A hand-held camera filmed the street scenes.
ex.zh: 一台手持摄像机拍摄了街景。

tip: hand-held 是“手持的”，如掌上游戏机。
scene: A small hand-held game device in a person's hands.

senses.en: the bars you hold to steer a bike

ex.en: Hold the handlebars firmly when you ride.
ex.zh: 骑车时握紧车把。

ex.en: The handlebars of the bicycle are too high for me.
ex.zh: 这辆自行车的车把对我来说太高了。

tip: handlebars 常用复数，指自行车/摩托车的车把。
scene: A close view of bicycle handlebars with a rider's hands on them.

senses.en: to spend time relaxing with friends

ex.en: We hang out at the café after school.
ex.zh: 放学后我们在咖啡馆闲逛。

ex.en: She hangs out with her cousins on weekends.
ex.zh: 她周末和表亲们一起玩。

tip: hang out 是口语“闲逛/消磨时间”。
scene: Teenagers hanging out and chatting at a café table.

senses.en: to end a phone call, or to hang clothes

ex.en: She hung up before I could say goodbye.
ex.zh: 我还没说再见她就挂断了。

ex.en: Hang up your coat by the door.
ex.zh: 把外套挂在门口。

tip: hang up 表示“挂断电话”或“挂起衣物”。
scene: A person ending a phone call and putting the phone down.

senses.en: a sport where you jump over a high bar

ex.en: She won the high jump at the sports day.
ex.zh: 她在运动会上赢得了跳高冠军。

ex.en: The high jump needs strong legs.
ex.zh: 跳高需要强壮的腿部力量。

tip: high jump 是跳高；long jump 是跳远。
scene: An athlete jumping over a high bar on a sports field.

senses.en: to raise something, or to delay

ex.en: Hold up your hand if you have a question.
ex.zh: 有问题请举手。

ex.en: The traffic was held up by an accident.
ex.zh: 交通因事故延误了。

tip: hold up 有“举起、延误、抢劫”等多个意思。
scene: A student raising their hand high in a classroom.

senses.en: the sport or activity of riding horses

ex.en: She goes horse-riding every weekend.
ex.zh: 她每周末去骑马。

ex.en: Horse-riding is popular in the countryside.
ex.zh: 骑马在乡村很受欢迎。

tip: horse-riding 与 riding 都指骑马运动。
scene: A rider on a horse trotting through a green field.

senses.en: used to ask about price or amount

ex.en: How much is this T-shirt?
ex.zh: 这件T恤多少钱？

ex.en: How much water do you drink a day?
ex.zh: 你每天喝多少水？

tip: how much 问价格或不可数名词的数量；how many 问可数。
scene: A customer asking the price of a T-shirt in a shop.

senses.en: a fast team sport played on ice with sticks

ex.en: Ice hockey is very fast and exciting.
ex.zh: 冰球运动非常快速刺激。

ex.en: The ice hockey team practises on the rink.
ex.zh: 冰球队在冰场上训练。

tip: ice hockey 是冰球运动；hockey 常指曲棍球。
scene: Ice hockey players with sticks skating on an ice rink.

senses.en: boots with blades for ice skating

ex.en: She laced up her ice skates carefully.
ex.zh: 她仔细系好冰鞋鞋带。

ex.en: My ice skates are a bit tight.
ex.zh: 我的冰鞋有点紧。

col: a pair of ice skates｜一双冰鞋
tip: ice skates 是滑冰冰鞋，常用复数。
scene: A pair of white ice skates with blades on an ice rink.

senses.en: to be ready for something that might happen

ex.en: Take an umbrella in case it rains.
ex.zh: 带把伞以防下雨。

ex.en: I'll write it down in case I forget.
ex.zh: 我把它记下来以防忘记。

tip: in case 引导从句表示“以防万一”。
scene: A person putting an umbrella in their bag while clouds gather.

senses.en: actually; used to give more information

ex.en: I thought he was a teacher; in fact, he's a doctor.
ex.zh: 我以为他是老师，事实上他是医生。

ex.en: In fact, the city is quite small.
ex.zh: 事实上，这座城市很小。

tip: in fact 用来纠正或补充事实。
scene: Two people talking, one correcting the other with a fact.

senses.en: into two equal parts

ex.en: Cut the apple in half and share it.
ex.zh: 把苹果切成两半分着吃。

ex.en: She folded the paper in half.
ex.zh: 她把纸对折。

tip: cut/divide in half 表示“分成两半”。
scene: A knife cutting an apple in half on a cutting board.

senses.en: written with a pen, not a pencil

ex.en: Please write your name in ink on the form.
ex.zh: 请用墨水笔在表格上写名字。

ex.en: The exam must be answered in ink.
ex.zh: 考试必须用墨水笔作答。

tip: in ink 是“用钢笔写”；in pencil 用铅笔写。
scene: A hand writing with a blue pen on a form.

senses.en: feeling strong love for someone

ex.en: They are deeply in love with each other.
ex.zh: 他们深深相爱。

ex.en: She fell in love with the city at first sight.
ex.zh: 她第一眼就爱上了这座城市。

tip: fall in love with 是“爱上”；be in love 是“恋爱中”。
scene: A couple holding hands and smiling on a park bench.

senses.en: arranged correctly or neatly

ex.en: Put the books in order on the shelf.
ex.zh: 把书按顺序放在书架上。

ex.en: Everything in the room is in order.
ex.zh: 房间里的一切都井然有序。

tip: in order 是“有序”；out of order 是“故障/混乱”。
scene: Books neatly arranged in order on a shelf.

senses.en: so that; for the purpose of

ex.en: She studies hard in order to pass the exam.
ex.zh: 她努力学习以便通过考试。

ex.en: In order to save money, we cook at home.
ex.zh: 为了省钱，我们在家做饭。

tip: in order to + 动词原形 表示目的“为了”。
scene: A student studying at night with a goal list on the desk.

senses.en: written with a pencil

ex.en: Draw the picture in pencil first.
ex.zh: 先用铅笔画图。

ex.en: The teacher said we could answer in pencil.
ex.zh: 老师说我们可以用铅笔作答。

tip: in pencil 是用铅笔；in ink 用钢笔。
scene: A hand drawing a sketch with a pencil on paper.

senses.en: finally, after everything

ex.en: In the end, we decided to stay home.
ex.zh: 最后我们决定待在家里。

ex.en: Everything worked out well in the end.
ex.zh: 最后一切都很顺利。

tip: in the end 表示“最终结果”；at the end 是“在…的末尾”。
scene: A family relaxing at home after deciding to stay in.

senses.en: early enough; before the deadline

ex.en: We arrived in time for the film.
ex.zh: 我们及时赶到了，赶上了电影。

ex.en: Finish your homework in time for dinner.
ex.zh: 及时完成作业好赶上晚饭。

tip: in time 是“及时，来得及”；on time 是“准时”。
scene: People rushing into a cinema just before the film starts.

senses.en: into two pieces

ex.en: The rope broke in two.
ex.zh: 绳子断成两段。

ex.en: She tore the paper in two.
ex.zh: 她把纸撕成两半。

tip: break/tear in two 表示“断/撕成两半”。
scene: A torn sheet of paper split in two on a table.

senses.en: a person who asks questions in an interview

ex.en: The interviewer asked about my work experience.
ex.zh: 面试官问了我的工作经历。

ex.en: She is an interviewer for a radio station.
ex.zh: 她是电台的采访者。

tip: interviewer 是提问方；interviewee 是被采访/面试者。
scene: An interviewer with a clipboard asking questions across a table.

senses.en: the job of making clothes smooth with an iron

ex.en: The ironing takes about half an hour.
ex.zh: 熨衣服大约需要半小时。

ex.en: She does the ironing on Sunday evenings.
ex.zh: 她周日晚熨衣服。

tip: do the ironing 是“熨衣服”；iron 是熨斗/熨烫。
scene: A person ironing a shirt on an ironing board in a room.
